decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is only weakly related to the firm's maritime crewing knowledge and has shown no measurable early results, so the firm lacks the absorptive capacity to interpret and improve it, making exit likely.

Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's existing maritime crewing and training knowledge, allowing it to interpret market signals and improve the service, so it is likely to be kept.

The maritime education programme leverages existing training centres and maritime institutions, with quantified partner network growth, so the firm can assimilate and apply this knowledge and will keep it.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services draw on the firm's strong safety, compliance and technical ship management knowledge, and the successful transfer of all monitoring plans shows clear positive results, so the firm will keep it.

The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and builds on its digital and compliance capabilities, making it easy to learn from and improve, so the firm will keep it.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is also integrated into PAL and leverages the firm's software and compliance knowledge, supporting learning and improvement, so the firm will keep it.
